raw_html: [[Absorb Beholder Spells]] - 8 Charges (Recharged/day: 8)[[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Absorb Beholder Spells]]:''' This effect absorbs most spells cast by [[beholder]] eyestalks. Only a few such spells can be absorbed before the item ceases to function and must have time to dissipate the absorbed energy.
